# Veeresh Bashetti — Personal Blog

> A personal blog by Veeresh Bashetti — a 22-year-old software developer based in India, writing honestly about developer life, personal finance, money mistakes, life lessons, and what it feels like to build from zero without generational wealth.

## Site

- URL: https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app
- Author: Veeresh Bashetti
- Topics: Personal Finance, Developer Life, Life Lessons, Career, Mental Health & Money

## Pages

- [Home](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/): Landing page with featured and recent blog posts.
- [Blog](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog): Full list of all published articles.
- [Categories](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/categories): Posts grouped by topic category.

## Blog Posts

### Life Lessons

- [The Childhood Mistake That Changed My Life Forever](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/childhood-mistake-changed-my-life)
  At 14, the author stole a phone from a family that treated him like their own. Eight years later, the guilt, the forgiveness, and the lessons from that one decision still shape everything he does. (7 min read, Featured)

- [I Spent ₹13,000 of My Scholarship Money on a CPU. It's Still Sitting in the Corner of My Room.](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/13k-second-hand-cpu-mistake-in-20s)
  The story of how buying a used CPU felt like a smart career investment — and how that single purchase taught more about money, guilt, and growing up than any finance book ever could. Tags: money mistakes, impulse buying, student finance India.

- [What My First Freelance Project Failure Taught Me About Money, Trust, and Saying What You Don't Know](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/first-project-failure-lessons)
  A complete matrimony platform was built and the client loved it — until one wrong number given with full confidence ended everything. Lessons on client communication, web hosting, and honesty. (Published: 2026-03-10)

- [Stop Comparing Yourself to People Online. It Is Costing You More Than You Think.](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/stop-comparing-yourself-social-media)
  The comparison habit doesn't just hurt confidence — it quietly drains money, time, and clarity about what one actually wants. A personal account and practical reframe. (9 min read, Published: 2026-03-25)

### Personal Finance

- [The Biggest Money Mistakes People Make in Their 20s (And Why We All Make Them)](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/money-mistakes-20s)

- [Why Suffering Without Generational Wealth Hits Different](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/suffering-without-generational-wealth)

- [How I Finally Started Budgeting — And Why Everything I Tried Before Failed](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/budgeting-for-beginners-india)
  After downloading four apps and reading five systems, nothing stuck — until a budget stopped being treated as punishment and became permission. A student's honest guide to budgeting in India. (Published: 2026-04-15)

- [The 30-Day Rule: The Only Spending Habit That Has Actually Changed My Life](https://veeresh-blog.vercel.app/blog/30-day-rule-impulse-buying)
  Ten personal finance books didn't change spending as much as one uncomfortable waiting period. How the 30-day rule works psychologically and the tools that make it stick. (Published: 2026-04-22)
